headline: Backblaze Reports Q3 2026 Results Driven by AI Strategy Growth
summary: Backblaze released its Q3 2026 financial slides, highlighting a 47% growth in B2 storage driven by its artificial intelligence strategy.
why: Quarterly earnings reports provide investors with key metrics regarding revenue growth, cloud storage demand, and adoption rates of AI-related infrastructure.
